verdict.rationale: An email platform could plausibly ship AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions. Deliverability Insights is described only as an in-app performance dashboard, not as AI-driven analysis, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
